caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a sculpture of a reclining deer with antlers, positioned on a rectangular base. The deer's body is a light tan or beige color with shading that gives the appearance of three-dimensional form and muscle definition, while its ears and nose are painted black. The horns show some detail and dimensionality, extending upward from the head. The base beneath the deer is a darker, almost black color. The overall background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with some subtle, uneven yellowish marks. The name "MILTON R. BEVIER" is printed in small, uppercase letters near the bottom right of the image. There are no other objects in the scene, and the layout centers the deer sculpture with considerable empty space around it.
title: Chalkware Deer
